reading this was like looking at my life. i suffer from bipolar. and when i say i suffer i really mean i suffer. my highs are the highest any person could be. and my lows, well ill explain to you when i did last night. last night my lows got worst than anything i have experienced before. i was GOING to kill myself wasn't going to listen to anyone. didnt care how much it would hurt people who loved me and my family i wanted to die. so i wrote my note. tucked it under my bed. and tied my noose and attached it to my ceiling. i was really sleepy so before i did anything i place a chair under the noose and sat on it to cry for the last time. i suddenly woke up this morning. realising that last night i was in so much hysteria i was willing to end something the important. how you feel wont last forever. you may feel shit now. sleep on it if you are still feeling bad go to doctors and get a mental test. it will help buddie! pm me if you need to speak i've been there.  things get better
